svg.aria-label: The cap K = [0, 6] by [0, 1] with rotation angle pi/2, outlined dashed: its niche N(K), shaded orange, rises far above K, and the wedge T_K(pi/4), outlined, has its corner x_K(pi/4) = (3, 2.59) outside K; what is left of K, the set K minus N(K), consists of two pieces near the ends, separated by the vertical line through x_K(pi/4)
